name: Aerial drone
summary: A small remote-controlled aircraft that carries a camera, so that a shot can fly over, round and through a scene.
how: Fly at 1 to 3 m from the subject for an FPV shot; fly higher for a survey shot.
Keep the horizon level in a calm shot; let it bank only for a fast FPV move.
Plan one continuous route; one take holds the scene.

origin.note: DJI sells the Phantom, a ready-to-fly drone that carries a small camera.

adoptions.via: Right Up Our Alley, a one-take FPV flight through a bowling alley, makes the drone a camera that flies through rooms.

sources.title: Right Up Our Alley, Jay Christensen (2021)
